name: anim_dom_transition
description: ENGINE-DRIVEN DOM TRANSITIONS. Mounting a different DOM must, by itself, produce composited motion: the diff already knows which old node became which new one, so any node whose rect moved gets a FLIP transform with NO timer, no app state and no per-node opt-in. This asserts the three things that can each silently fail: (1) a layout change SEEDS animations at all, (2) the sampled transform reaches css_current_transform_values — the map the rasteriser and the hit-tester read, not a parallel bookkeeping copy — via the `published` flag, and (3) stepping to completion CLEARS them, because an animation that never settles leaves the node permanently offset by its last sample. Time is stepped in exact microseconds rather than slept, so the trajectory is a pure function of how many steps ran and cannot differ between a fast and a slow machine. XFAIL, with a known cause rather than a mystery: the seeding lives in dll/src/desktop/shell2/common/layout.rs::regenerate_layout, and the HEADLESS runner is in azul-layout — a lower crate that cannot call into azul-dll. So the runner has its own layout path and never reaches the diff seam, and this scenario reports active:0 after a layout change. The fix is to move the seeding down into azul-layout (LayoutWindow), which is where it belongs anyway: deriving animations from a DOM diff is engine logic, not shell logic. Flip this to expect:pass once that lands — the assertions themselves are correct and are what caught the split. Also asserts the RETENTION lifecycle: removing #sidebar must retain the departing subtree (zombies:1) so it has something to animate out, and stepping to completion must reap it exactly once (zombies:0) — a zombie outliving its animation is a leak, one vanishing early took live state off screen mid-flight. The settle wait_frame before assert_state_machines_idle is load-bearing: retirement legitimately regenerates the display list (the reference frames must go), so the frame that renders that regeneration reports full damage — idle is reached on the NEXT frame, and the idle checks are documented to be driven as 'wait_frame x K -> assert'. AMENDED for the no-defaults ruling: retention is DECLARED (-azul-animation-out on the sidebar, flyOutLeft @keyframes) - the zombie lifecycle asserts pin the declared path; an undeclared unmount would simply disappear.
